column1: # SQL fact counters: one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex). srcmorph counts the pattern's
# matches over the whole source file and writes them as exact facts before the AI summary.
# The [ignore] line runs first and reads the file as a lexer does, leftmost region first: it blanks
# -- comments, '...' string literals ('' and a backslash escape a quote, as in MySQL) and /* ... */
# block comments, keeping the line breaks, so a /* inside a string or a -- comment opens nothing. It
# keeps MySQL's /*! ... */ version comments and Oracle's /*+ ... */ hints, which hold real SQL. A /*
# that is never closed comments out the rest of the file, as PostgreSQL and MySQL read it; a nested
# PostgreSQL comment ends at its first */. Statements are counted where they start a line (after
# spaces or tabs, never across a line break, which keeps a long blanked region linear),
# case-insensitive, for PostgreSQL, MySQL, T-SQL and Oracle. An INSERT counts with or without INTO
# (MySQL, T-SQL), after an Oracle /*+ hint */ and as INSERT ALL / FIRST, not as the INSERT branch of
# a MERGE or a trigger's event list; SQLite's INSERT OR REPLACE and a view inside a mysqldump /*!50001
# */ comment are not seen. A TYPE BODY, a MATERIALIZED VIEW LOG, a DATABASE LINK and a DATABASE
# SCOPED CREDENTIAL are not counted. "VALUES rows (approx)" counts the row tuples of VALUES lists (a
# tuple after VALUES or after "),"), so a multi-row INSERT counts every row; rows an INSERT ...
# SELECT reads from a table are not seen, and a tuple nested inside a row counts once more.
